༄༅/ /dpal dus kyi 'khor lo'i mngon rtogs kyi yan lag tu sbyin bsreg gi lag len ye shes 'od kyi dra ba zhes bya ba bzhugs/ /

tei:div.tei:p: ༄༅// dpal dus kyi 'khor lo'i mngon rtogs kyi yan lag tu sbyin bsreg gi lag len ye shes 'od kyi dra ba zhes bya ba bzhugs//

"$ ༄༅// dpal ldan raṃ dang ho las byung ba thams cad bsreg za ba// phyi rol khams dang phung po la sogs bud shing thams cad kun// 'jig rten las dang 'jig rten 'das pa'i don grub mchog rtsol ba// ral pa gsum ldan drang srong ye shes me la phyag 'tshal lo// 'jam pa'i dbyangs kyis legs bsdus rgyud// phyag na pad mos rnam phye ba'i// sbyin bsreg las rnams bsgrub byed pa// de yi lag len gsal bar bya// sgrub pa pos bzlas pa bye ba byas nas sbyin bsreg 'bum phrag bcu byas pas las thams cad bsgrub pa'am dbang dang rab tu gnas pa dang las phra'u gzhan yang rung ste/ sbyin bsreg gi bsgrub pa la don gsum ste/ gnas dang*/ dus phyogs kha lta lugs dang*/ thab kyi tshad dbyibs kha dog mtshan ma dang bcas pa dang*/ dgang blugs mchod yon gyi snod// shing dang bsreg rdzas rnams kyis sngon 'gro dang*/ me lha'i sbyin bsreg dngos dang*/ dkyil 'khor gyi lha dang*/ dkyil 'khor gyi lha'i dang gnyis kyis dngos gzhi dang*/ rjes kyi bya ba'o// dang po ni dben pa'am/ rgyal po la sogs pa'i grong ngam/ dkyil 'khor gyi khang pa'i yang phyogs mtshams te/ byang dang dbang ldan du zhi ba dang rgyas pa/ shar du dbye ba dang bskrad pa/ mer bsad pa lhor dgug pa/ bden bral du dbang*/ nub du rengs pa dang phur bus gdab pa/ rlung du rmugs pa dang rmongs pa dang*/ dbus su las thams cad pa ste/ 'di ni nges pa'o// gzhan yang dkar zhing dang ba zhi ba dang*/ ro bsregs pa 'jigs pa'i sa la mngon spyod la sogs pa thams cad la rgyud so so nas gsungs so// de bzhin du zhi ba la lhor stan bting la kha byang du blta'o// rgyas pa la byang shar du blta'o// bsad pa la shar du/ bskrad pa dang dbye ba la mer/ dbang la lhor/ dgug pa la lho nub/ rmongs pa la nub tu rengs pa la nub byang du ltas pas bya'o// 'od kyi snye mar/ zhi ba la shar du/ rgyas pa la byang du/

dbang la nub tu/ bsad pas lhor blta ste bya'o zhes rgyud gzhan gyi dgongs pa'o// dus ni zhag gcig la thun brgyad du gnas pa'i snga dro dang po zhi ba/ gnyis pa rgyas pa/ gsum pa bsad pa/ bzhi pa bskrad pa/ lnga pa dbang*/ drug par dgug pa/ bdun pa rmongs pa/ brgyad pa rengs pa bya ste/ de bzhin du thun phyed kyang sbyar te/ nyin brgyad mtshan brgyad rim pa ltar bya ste/ dus sbyor dang gza' rnams kyang so so'i dus su bya ba yin te/ bzlog pa ni mi 'grub pa la sogs pa 'bras bu phyin ci log tu 'gyur bas so// thab khung ni zhi ba la zlum po dbus su pad+ma 'dab brgyad de nyid kyis mtshan pa/ khru gang ba dkar ba'o// rgyas pa la gru bzhi 'khor los mtshan pa khru do pa dkar ser ro// bsad pa la zla gam gri gug gis mtshan pa khru phyed dang gnyis pa nag pa'o// dbye ba la zur lnga la ral gris mtshan pa khru gang ba dmar nag go dbang la zur bdun pa mdas mtshan pa sor bzhi bcu pa dmar ser ro// dgug pa la zur sum lcags kyus mtshan pa sor nyi shu pa dmar po'o// rmongs pa la zur drug pa sbrul gyis mtshan pa sor sum cu pa rab tu dmar ba'o// rengs pa la zur brgyad pa lcags sgrog gis mtshan pa sor drug cu pa rab tu ser ba ste/ thams cad kyang thab khung gi phyed kyi tshad zabs su bru'o// drug cha ni kha khyer/ bcu gnyis cha gcig mchu ste mtshan pa so so'i phreng ba'o// zhi rgyas la phyi ru kha khyer dang mnyam pa'i pad+ma bya'o// las thams cad pa la dbus su rdo rje ljang khus mtshan pa bya'o// 'dir thams cad nang dang 'byung ba'i yon tan gyi rim pas so// sgo brgyan byed na dkyil 'khor gyi rim pas byed par bshad do// dgang gzar ni snyim pa'i rnam pa lta bu phyi rol gru bzhi pa dpangs sor gcig pa mthil mnyam pa pad mas mtshan pa/ rtse mo sor gnyis kyi nang du wa'i rnam pa/ de'i mchu ru rdo rje rtse lnga pa'i dbus su bcud 'dzag pa sor bzhi'o// yu ba khru gang tsam rdo rje nor bu mtshan pa'o// blugs gzar yu ba snga ma lta bu la sor drug pa la pad mas mtshan pa ste nang du snying kha nas yar mar gyis dag pa'o// de bzhin las so so'i mtshan ma la sogs pa thab bzhin du ste/

yu ba yang 'bar 'dzag gi rim pas ring ba la gtsug gtor nas gsang ba'i bar du 'gyur ro// mchod yon gyi snod kyang zhi ba la shel kham phor gyi dbyibs pad mas mtshan pa lte ba sor bzhi gzhan sor bzhi ste brgyad pa'o// de bzhin du dngul thod pa lcags gser zangs shing rnams rim pas so// de med na de rnams kyis byugs pa kha dog so so yang ngo*// yam shing ni zhi ba dang rgyas pa la a shad la sogs pa dri zhim ro mngar ba rnams so// bsad pa mi rus the'u chung tsam mo// dbye ba dang bskrad pa la bya rog gi sgro'o// dbang la seng ldeng la sogs pa'o// dgug pa la shwa'o// rmongs pa la rta ru ra'o// rengs pa la bil pa'o// sor bcu gnyis pa mthe bo tsam mthe'u chung tsam lnga brgya'o// sreg rdzas gtso bo ni zhi ba la 'o ma dang dur ba sbags la/ rgyas pa la mar dang 'bru lnga'o// bsad pa la shwa khrag dang dug go// bskrad pa dang dbye ba la mi'i zhag dang ke tshe'o/ dbang la dngul dang ka ra bi ra'i me tog la sogs pa'o// dgug pa la dri chu bil ba'i 'dab ma la sogs pa'o// rengs pa la mchil ma dang*/ ling ga la phur pa'i me tog rnying pa'o// rmongs pa la chang dang dha ru la sogs pa'o// gzhan ni ji ltar rnyed pas bya'o// gzhan yang 'dug stangs la sogs pa bstan te/ zhi ba la dkyil dkrung rgyas pa la rdo rje dkyil dkrung*/ bsad pa la rus sbal ltar bskum pa/ bskrad pa dang dbye ba la tsog pu/ dbang la g.yon gyi phyed dkyil dkrung*/ dgug pa dang dbye ba g.yas phyed dkyil rmongs pa la rkang pa g.yon pas bshang sgo mnan la/ rengs pa la g.yas te 'dug stangs brgyad do// mchod pa ni zhi rgyas la dri zhim pa dkar po/ bsad bskrad dbye ba la ro tsha ba dang*/ tsher ma can dang nag po/ dbang dgug pa dmar po/ rmongs pa dang rengs pa la ser po'o// spos ni bsil ba dang*/ dug khrag dang bcas pa dang*/ bska ba dang gu gul rgya skags dang bcas pa rnams go rims bzhin no// de bzhin du lha bshos kyang rim pas 'o zan zho zan mchin pa/

shwa/ mar zan/ til mar dang bcas pa'i zan/ sran zan/ mon sran nag po'i zan rnams so// dbyug pa yang tsan dan dkar po/ khrag dang ro sol/ gur gum 'gri ham̐/ yung ba gla rtsi rnams so/ mar me yang mar dang mi'i zhag dang*/ til dang*/ 'dzo ti/ sma ti dang*/ se 'bru'i mar rnams rim pas so// de bzhin du 'bru yang*/ sa lu dang ske tshe dang*/ yungs dkar dang sran chung rnams so/ mchod rdzas gzhan kha dog dang dbyibs dang dris phye ba'o// de ltar thab byas nas las dang mthun pa thab kyi dbyibs ltar brtsig cing mchod pa dang gtor ma bsham/ rdo rje slob dpon gyi gdan g.yas su/ dgang blugs kyi gdan g.yon du mchod yon gdan dbus su bsreg rdzas rnams bkod la thab tu ku sha bkram pa ni sngon du bya ba'o// gnyis pa dngos gzhi ni/ bdag nyid rdo rje'i skur bsgoms nas thab bsrung ba'i don du phur bus gdab pa byas nas/ de nas rdo rje dang bcas pa byin gyis brlabs pa'i lag pas/ oṃ āḥhūm̐ hraḥphaṭa ces bsang gtor byas nas/ bdag bskyed pa'i snying khar me lha lhag par gnas pa byas nas zhi rgyas la bram ze'i khyim nas/ bsad pa la sogs pa rmangs rigs/ dbang dgug rgyal rigs/ rengs pa phur bus gdab pa/ rdo rje rigs kyi khyim nas byung ba'i me sbar la/ rlung g.yab kyis bus te/ oṃ dzā la dzā la hūm̐ zhes brjod nas/ rdo rje'i me de nyid las 'phros pas bgegs bsal la/ mtshan ma so so las bskyed par bya ste/ thams cad kyang zhal gcig phyag bzhi pa spyan gsum pa/ ral pa'i cod pan gdan pad ma dang nyi ma dang ra la gnas pa ste/ las thams cad la g.yas na rdo rje dang bgrang phreng*/ g.yon dril bu dang pad ma can ljang khu'o// mi bskyod pa'i dbu rgyan can no// zhi ba la g.yas su pad ma dang ral gri phreng bar bcas pa/ g.yon bum pa dang dung*/ sku mdog dkar po snang ba mtha' yas kyis brgyan pa'o// rgyas pa la g.yas 'khor lo dang mu tig phreng ba g.yon pad ma dang spyi blugs so// drag po la nag po g.yas gri gug rtse gsum/

g.yon thod pa kha ṭ+wāṃ can don grub kyis brgyan pa'o// bskrod pa g.yas ral gri rtse gsum/ g.yon mthun no/ dbang la dmar po g.yas mda' dang rin chen/ g.yon gzhu dang me long can/ rin chen 'byung ldan gyis brgyan pa'o// 'gugs pa la g.yas rdo rje lcags kyu dang*/ rin chen can/ g.yon zhags pa me long ngo*// rmongs pa la g.yas sbrul dang dbyug pa/ g.yon 'khor lo dang thod pa'o// rengs pa dang phur bus gdab pa la g.yas lcags sgrog tho ba/ g.yon 'khor lo dang phur bu can ser po rnam snang gis brgyan pa'o// de ltar las dang mthun par bskyed nas ye shes kyi me lha spyan drang pa ni/ tshur gshegs tshur gshegs 'byung po che// gzi brjid ldan pa me yi lha// me lha drang srong bram ze mchog /'bar ba'i sku ni rgyan gyis brgyan// bsregs blugs zhal zas bzhes slad du// 'bar ba'i gdan la bzhugs su gsol// oṃ ā+e hi ā+e hi/ ma ha bhu ta/ dhe ba ri shi/ dhu dza sa ta ma/ gh+ri he t+ya/ a yu dam̐/ ma hā ra rmi/ a smi na sa ni/ hi dho bha bā/ badz+ra dha ra a dz+nya pa yā ti swā hā/ zhes brjod nas/ dza hūm̐ bam̐ ho his dgug gzhug bcing dbang du bya zhing dgyes par byas nas/ oṃ pra bā ra sa ta ka ra/ argam̐ ma ha ra smi na pra ti tsa swā hā zhes mchod yon 'bul/ de bzhin du argam̐ gyi sar/ pa t+yam̐ dang a dz+nya ma nam̐ dang*/ a bh+yo khya nam̐ bcug la/ zhabs bsil dang*/ zhal bsil dang*/ gsang gtor phul la/ yang oṃ badz+ra gham̐ dham̐ pra ti tsa ye swā hā/ de bzhin du/ oṃ badz+ra pus pam̐ ma lā+e/ badz+ra dhu pe/ badz+ra dhi pa/ badz+ra a k+ṣa t+ye ta/ badz+ra ne pe t+ye/ badz+ra bha trai/ badz+ra ni t+ye/ badz+ra ha s+ye/ badz+ra la s+ye/ badz+ra ghi te/ badz+ra ka mā+e/ pra ti tsa ye swa hā/ zhes lha mo bcu gnyis kyis mchod la/ oṃ sarba pa pam̐/ dha ha na badz+ra ag ne/ badz+ra sa twa sarba pa pam̐/ dha ha na dha ha na swā hā zhes 'dod pa'i me bkug nas/ oṃ badz+ra a na lā/ sarba bhu dhan dza la yā/

sarba bha smi ku ru/ sarba dza na dhus tra na hūm̐ phaṭa swā hā/ zhes brjod la/ dam tshig sgrags nas/ me'i ltas rtag pa'i don du/ mar dgang blugs gsum tsam byin nas/ las so so dang mthun par ma gyur na khro bo'i sngags kyis bsang ngo*// de nas bsreg rdzas thams cad 'og nas 'byung ba bzhin// oṃ ag ne ye swa hā/ zhes pa dang ldan pas ci rigs pa dbul bar bya ste/ go rim ni/ dang po sbyangs te/ oṃ pri swā hā/ zhun mar sbyang pa'i sngags so/ oṃ āḥ swā hā/ yam shing gi'o/ oṃ dza swā hā/ 'bru dag par bya ba'o// oṃ ku ru ku ru swā hā/ rdzas gzhan sbyang pa'i sngags so/ thog mar mar gyi dgang blugs 'bul// de bzhin yam shing bsregs byas nas// til dang dur ba 'bras zho zan// ku sha de nas gzhan rnams so// phyag rgya ni lag pa g.yon phyi kan du byas g.yas mchog sbyin pa bzhin du ste/ rdzas gzhan rnams ni mtheb srin gyis 'bul lo// 'bul ba'i gnas ni/ khu ba'i rdzas ni zhal du'o// yam shing la sogs pa 'od kyi dkyil 'khor la'o// zho zan til la sogs phyag tu'o// dri thugs khar ro// me tog dbu la'o// bdug spos shangs la'o// mar me dang yon chab mdun du'o// gzhan yang rang gi nang du bsgoms pa dang ye shes kyi me lha phyir/ sngags kyi tshig 'di lta ste oṃ āḥhūm̐ ho haṃ k+ṣa swā hā/ rtsa ba la brgya rtsa brgyad do// hūm̐ hūm̐ hrī hrī hra hrā swa hā/ yan lag la brgya rtsa brgyad do/ a ā i ī ri rī u ū li lī am̐ āḥ phung po khams la brgya rtsa brgyad do/ a ā e ā+ai ar ār o ā+o al al am̐ āḥswa hā/ skye mched bcu gnyis la brgya rtsa brgyad do/ ha hā ya yā ra rā ba bā la lā ham̐ ha swā hā zhes las kyi dbang po dang yul la brgya rtsa brgyad de/ lnga brgya dang bzhi bcu zhes so// de nas/ oṃ bhur bhu ba swā hā/ na mo dhe bā+e bh+yaḥ sa tri pra dz+ya bh+yaḥ

sa h+ya ra dzā bh+yaḥ swā ta pi ḍi bh+yaḥ a lam̐ bhu te bh+yaḥ bha sha ta in tra yā+e zhes brjod nas/ bstod pa ni/ tshangs pa 'jig rten skyong ba'o// gzi brjid ldan pa me yi lha// 'od du 'bar ba'i rang bzhin te// zhi ba la sogs lha dpal yin// zhi ba'i zhal la chu gter phyag /zhi sogs rgyan dang cha lugs can// g.yas na dbyug gu bgrang phreng 'dzin// g.yon na spyi blugs chu skyes bsnams// ral pa ser skya mdzes pa can// spyan ni yangs la gos dang bcas// me yi lha la phyag 'tshal bstod// zhi ba la sogs las rnams mdzod/ ces brjod la slar yang zhabs bsil la sogs pa phul la/ oṃ āḥhūm̐ ka yā wāka tsi t+ta sa bha bā shud dho ham̐ zhes bsangs la/ zhu zhing 'bar bar gyur pa'am/ phyir me'i phyogs su bzhag kyang rung ste/ de rnams ni me lha'i sbyin bsreg go /de nas ye shes kyi dkyil 'khor rgyas bsdus gang yang rung ba bskyed la ye shes dgug cing ro mnyam gyi bar byas la/ oṃ āḥhūm̐ ho tri dha du ke sha ra ka lā tsa kra ar+gham̐ pra ti tsa swā hā/ zhes mchod yon dang*/ pa t+yaṃ dang*/ a ts+tsha ma nam̐ dang*/ pro k+ṣa nam̐ gis zhabs bsil zhal bsil 'thor 'thung phul la/ sa pa ri wa ra bha ga bān me bha ra to bha/ bha shir sha nam̐n tsā zhes brjod la/ phyi nang gi mchod pa rnams byas nas/ de nas oṃ āḥhūm̐ ho haṃ k+ṣa ma la bha ra yā phaṭa swa hā zhes mar me 'bul lo// gzhan me lha dang lha thams cad rdzas rnams bsreg pa'i sngags bye brag pa ni/ oṃ sarba pa pam̐ da ha na badz+ra ye swa hā/ zhi ba'i don du til rnams kyi'o// oṃ badz+ra a yu she swa hā/ tshe ring pa'i don du dur ba rnams kyi'o// oṃ badz+ra pus tra ye swa hā/ rgyas pa'i don du 'bras kyi'o// oṃ sarba swam̐ bha da swa hā/ phun sum 'tshogs pa'i don du zho zan dang zas mchog gi'o// oṃ a pra ti ha ta badz+ra ye swa hā/ bsrung ba'i don du ku sha rnams kyi'o// oṃ badz+ra bhi dza ya swā hā 'bras so ba'i 'o// oṃ ma ha bhi t+ya swa hā nas kyi'o// oṃ ma hā pa la ye swā hā sran ma ma sha'o// oṃ badz+ra ghasma ri swā hā gro'i 'o// oṃ badz+ra ya dz+nya ye swa hā u du 'bar ba'i 'o// oṃ bho ti bhi k+ṣa ya swā hā byang chub shing gi'i 'o// oṃ badz+ra la ta yā swā hā/

glag sha'o/ oṃ badz+ra ku be ra ye swā hā/ n+ya kro ta'i 'o// oṃ ha sa ka ra yā swā hā/ a mra'i 'o// oṃ badz+ra arka ya swā hā/ mchod sbyin shing gi'i 'o// oṃ badz+ra bh+ra mā na ye swā hā/ pa la sha'i 'o// oṃ badz+ra gha tra yā+e swā hā/ seng ldeng gi'i 'o// o badz+ra shru pa ya swā hā/ bhai kaṃ ka'i 'o// oṃ badz+ra shi ba yā swā hā/ shing pa ma'i 'o// oṃ sarba to bha tra yā swā hā/ gham̐ bha ri'i 'o// oṃ badz+ra shi kha ra ye swā hā/ a ba ma rga'i 'o// rdzas lhag ma rnams ni tshim par bya ba'i lha'i sngags kyis 'bul lo// bsreg bya thams cad bdud rtsi lngas bsgo bar bya'o// 'dir rgyas par ni mchod mchog tu gsungs pa'i sngags la na ma'i mtha' dor la swā hā bcug nas bya bar gsungs so// oṃ na mo ghu ru bhu ta bo te swā ta bh+ya swā hā nas thugs dkyil lam/ rdzogs pa sngar gang bskyed pa'i sngags kyis bya ba ni dkyil 'khor mchod pa'i sbyin bsreg yin no// lha bye brag pa la zhi rgyas la na mo'i mtha' can/ dgug pa la bho'u shad ta/ dbang la bha shad ta/ mngon spyod dang dbye ba dang*/ bskrad pa dang bsad pa la ma ra ya hūm̐/ phur bus gdab pa la ki la ya phaṭa/ rengs pa la staṃ bha ya/ rmongs pa la mo ha ya la sogs pa'am/ gzhan yang zhi ba la shan t+yi ku ru/ rgyas pa la pus ting ku ru/ dbang la pa sham̐ ku ru/ drag po la ma ra ya phaṭa/ dgug pa la a kar sha ya/ bskrad pa la u tsa ta ya la sogs pa rgyud gzhan du gsungs pa'i mtha' bsgyur dang bcas pa ni 'phrin las bsgrub pa'i sbyin bsreg go /mdor na ji ltar 'byor pa'i rnam pa 'bul zhing 'dod pa'i don la gsol ba btab la/ bzod par gsol zhing gshegs su gsol te/ rang gi lus la bsdu'o// dngos gzhi'o// rjes kyi bya ba ni slar me lha dgug cing*/ bsreg rdzas kyi lhag ma phul la/ bsod nams 'dod pa dag gis kyang 'bul du bcug ste/ bzod par gsol ba ni/

gang yang bdag blo gti mug pas// nyes byas cung zad gang bgyis pa// gang phyir lus can skyabs yin phyir// mgon po khyed de bzod par gsol// gang yang nus pa ma mchis dang*// ma rnyed yongs su ma shes pa// 'dir ni byas dang byed 'gyur nyid// de kun gtso bos bzod mdzod rigs// zhes brjod cing gtor ma dngos la dngos grub blang ngo*// oṃ dzā gha tsh+tsha gham̐ tsh+tsha/ ma ha ra smi swa twa nam̐/ sam̐ ghi pa to ho/ pu na ra ga mi sha swa/ dhe bā sha dza dha ra ya mi swa hā/ zhes brjod la gsang gtor dang zhal bsil phul la/ khyed kyis sems can don kun mdzad// rjes su mthun pa'i dngos grub gsol/ sangs rgyas yul du gshegs nas kyang*// slar yang byon par mdzad du gsol// zhes bya bas yang dag par bskul nas/ rang gi sngags dang*// oṃ āḥhūm̐ mu zhes brjod cing gshegs su gsol lo// gzhan yang*/ 'jig rten pa'i lha thab khung tu 'god par 'dod na/ dam tshig sems dpa' bskyed pa dang*// ye shes sems dpa' dgug pa dang*// dam la gnas par bya ba dang*/ mchod pa dang*/ sbyin bsreg la sogs pa me lha'i bzhin du sbyar bar bya'o// phyis kyang me lha dang mtshungs par gshegs su gsol/ thal ba ni zhi rgyas la chu bor dor ba dang*/ dbang dgug la phyar ba'am lam du dor ba'am/ drag po la mnan pa la sogs pa bya'o// rjes kyi bya ba'o// nang gi rnal 'byor dang ldan pas lag pa g.yas g.yon dgang blugs snying khar lha bskyed nas/ lte ba'i me lhag par gnas nas bza' btung la sogs pa thams cad byin gyis brlabs te 'bul ba ni/ nang gi sbyin bsreg ste/ snying kha'i dkyil 'khor sbyin bsreg bya// zhi ba'i btung ba bzhin myangs nas// dngos grub mchog ni thob par 'gyur// zhes bshad do/ gzhan yang*/ mgo bo'i thod pa nyid kyang ni// sbyin bsreg snod du nye bar brjod// ro ma blugs gzar bshad pa ste// snying kha'i chos 'khor brkyang ma ni// dgang gzar bdag nyid rnam par bstan// lte ba'i dkyil 'khor nyid kyang thab// zhes bde ba chen po gnyis su med pa ni sbyin bsreg bla na med pa ste/

de ltar brtson pa ni phyi'i sbyin bsreg rnams kyang rung pa nyid de nges pa 'di'i rgyud thams cad du gsungs so// ye shes gtum mo rab tu 'bar ba'i sgra grags kyis// rnam rtog bdud kyi bud shing zhum shing rab bsregs nas// bde dang stong pa rab 'bar zhun mar bdud rtsi'i rgyun// rab 'bab ye shes sems kyi me lha mnyes gyur cig /kā lā pa ru rab grags pa/ grags pa pad dkar las byung pa// phyi nang sbrang rtsi dag gi rgyun// ring mo zhig ste myong ba yin// dge bas sems can thams cad kyi// ye shes bde 'od 'bar byed shog /'gal dang 'khrul pa gang mchis pa// mkha' 'gro'i tshogs kyis bzod par mdzod// dpal dus kyi 'khor lo'i sbyin bsreg gi cho ga lag tu blang ba'i rim pa/ ye shes 'od zer dra ba zhes bya ba/ rang byung rdo rjes mtshur phu'i ri khrod du sbyar ba'o/// /
